song_craft: Daily-lesson digest song (20v, saMgraha sane-register per Swamiji): mark-and-frame (vv1-3: pain-joy-mark, unshowing-wiped, live-die-else) -> works fabric (vv4-13: pride-shines, birth-telling, chain-seen, pair-grounded, sense-wine, other-unknown, foot-rubbed, linger-question, own-hands, palace-climbed) -> widening close (vv14-20: relish-offered, widen-sports, doubt-free, poison-nectar, prattle-ditties, unwilled-will, bottomless-entered). Opens held open throughout (live kAlikA-fork minted).

lines: In brief, Lord —
hear my pain-joy-mark: joy is this, meeting Thee; parted from the Master — pain.
l4.sanskrit_cite: saṃgrahena sukhaduḥkhalakṣaṇaṃ māṃ prati sthitam idaṃ śṛṇu prabho saukhyam eṣa bhavatā samāgamaḥ svāminā viraha eva duḥkhitā

verses.craft: Pain-joy-mark defined (deliberate doctrine not effusion per Swamiji; saMgraha sane-register); lakSaNa/viraha opens kept.
verses.rejected: (a) characteristic->definition killed open. (b) absence->separation killed double.
verses.reads: argmap Q+INF (+UNC ["Whether 'sukhaduḥkhalakṣaṇaṃ' means 'definition of pleasure and pain' or 'characteristic of pleasure and pain' is unresolved.", "Whether 'viraha' means 'separation' or 'absence' is unresolved.", "Swamiji: ch13+14 composed 'in his senses' (saṅgraha = sane summary) vs the gone/ecstatic chapters — the definition-verse is deliberate doctrine, not effusion."]) / C1 essence / rasa / L2+L3 voice

lines: Inside even, exceeding subtle — the Thee-unshowing spell in me:
her too, Ruler, wipe from all sides; Thine own stainless shape show.
l4.sanskrit_cite: antar apy atitarām aṇīyasī yā tvadaprathanakālikāsti me tām apīśa parimṛjya sarvataḥ svaṃ svarūpam amalaṃ prakāśaya

verses.craft: Thee-unshowing spell wiped all-sides; stainless-shape shown; aNIyasI/parimRjya opens + kAlikA-fork live per UNC (minted, not resolved).
verses.rejected: (a) minute->subtle killed double. (b) resolving fork killed minted-open.
verses.reads: argmap Q+INF (+UNC ["Whether 'aṇīyasī' means 'minute' or 'subtle' is unresolved.", "Whether 'parimṛjya' means 'wiping away' or 'removing' is unresolved.", 'Swamiji (Hymns to Shiva ch13) reads the kālikā as the āṇavamala remnant — māyīya and kārma malas already gone, only the minute internal dirt blocking perception remains; minted as live L0 fork.']) / C1 essence / rasa / L2+L3 voice

lines: In Thy frame — world-filled, knowing-nectar-sapped, unending —
abiding, ever worshiping the Lord: live, die, else — be mine.
l4.sanskrit_cite: tāvake vapuṣi viśvanirbhare citsudhārasamaye niratyaye tiṣṭhataḥ satatam arcataḥ prabhuṃ jīvitaṃ mṛtam athānyad astu me

verses.craft: Live-die-else be-mine; ever-worshiping in frame; jIvitam/mRtanyad opens + Swamiji span kept.
verses.rejected: (a) live-or-die->live-and-die killed: or-or kept. (b) else->other killed open.
verses.reads: argmap Q+INF (+UNC ["Whether 'jīvitaṃ mṛtam' means 'let me live or die' or 'whether living or dead' is unresolved.", "Whether 'anyad' means 'other' or 'anything else' is unresolved.", "Swamiji: jīvitam/mṛtam/anyad spans hell, heaven, even mokṣa — all indifferent against constant worship; the verse's only desire is satatam arcana."]) / C1 essence / rasa / L2+L3 voice

lines: 'Lord am I — I shapely indeed, learned, loved —
who else? my like in the world?' — so shines pride, Thy lovers', highly.
l4.sanskrit_cite: īśvaro 'ham aham eva rūpavān paṇḍito 'smi subhago 'smi ko 'paraḥ matsamo 'sti jagatīti śobhate mānitā tvadanurāgiṇaḥ param

verses.craft: Lovers-pride shines highly (Swamiji maxim: beautiful-because-attached); mAnitA/param opens kept.
verses.rejected: (a) pride->ego killed open. (b) dampening maxim killed: shines.
verses.reads: argmap Q+INF (+UNC ["Whether 'mānitā' means 'ego' or 'pride' is unresolved.", "Whether 'param' means 'supreme' or 'ultimately' is unresolved.", "Swamiji: this ego (mānitā) SHINES in devotees but damns the detached ('let them go to the dogs'); maxim: he who is attached to God is beautiful because love for God is charming."]) / C1 essence / rasa / L2+L3 voice

lines: God of gods — birth won me from telling Thy non-dual nectar that swallows fame.
So by things-just-as-they-stand-knowing make me foot-worship-fit.
l4.sanskrit_cite: devadeva bhavadadvayāmṛtākhyātisaṃharaṇalabdhajanmanā tad yathāsthitapadārthasaṃvidā māṃ kuruṣva caraṇārcanocitam

verses.craft: Birth-from-telling; things-just-as-stand knowing fits worship (labdha/yathAsthita opens kept).
verses.rejected: (a) resolving opens killed x2.
verses.reads: argmap Q+INF (+UNC ["Whether 'labdhajanmanā' means 'born of' or 'attained through' is unresolved.", "Whether 'yathāsthitapadārtha' means 'things as they stand' or 'things as they are' is unresolved."]) / C1 essence / rasa / L2+L3 voice

verses.craft: Thought-seen-touched chain; feast-mine-ever; dhyAyate/anubhAvataH opens kept.
verses.rejected: (a) passive-vs-active killed open. (b) grace-vs-experience killed double.
